readings.moment: When the temple struck nine at dinner, when watches were put on the cloth
When the temple struck nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
Félix heard the temple strike ten while alone in the library
A quarter past ten: someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
Eighteen minutes past ten: a thump on the floor right above him in the atelier
After the thump: the uncle's repeater struck ten slow deep notes, which Félix counted
Twenty-one minutes past ten: someone came quickly down the stairs
Thirty-two minutes past ten: Bastien Girard came into the library
Félix and Girard sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven

durations: ten years (Félix's watch has given him trouble for ten years)
four years (the uncle had been four years on the repeater)
from 10:32 until 11:00 (Girard and Félix sat together until the temple struck eleven; implied, about 28 minutes)
from 10:15 to 10:18 (between the figure on the stairs and the thump; implied, 3 minutes)
from 10:18 to 10:21 (between the thump and the figure coming down the stairs; implied, 3 minutes)
whereabouts: Félix was at dinner in the dining room with the family and the uncle when the temple struck nine; the uncle went round the table inspecting the watches
Girard was present at dinner, where he laughed at the uncle's remark about Félix's watch
Odile was present at dinner, where she looked at her plate
Félix went up to the library after dinner
Félix drank brandy in the library and stayed there alone
Félix stayed in the library and did not look at his watch when the temple struck ten
At 10:15 someone (unidentified) went quickly up the stairs past the library door, which was shut
The thump at 10:18 was on the floor in the atelier, directly above the library; Félix said the library is directly under the uncle's bench
The aunt was playing the piano downstairs when the thump came
At 10:21 someone (unidentified) came quickly down the stairs, past the shut library door
Félix stayed where he was in the library after the thump and finished the brandy
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 and sat with Félix there until the temple struck eleven
